title: Your VA Isn't the Problem. The Way You're Using Them Is.
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: Your VA isn't the problem. The way you're using them is.
Most support runs like a ticket queue — nothing moves until you ask.
Workflow ownership means the whole process runs without you touching it.
Anticipation is the layer above that — prep ready before you even open the invite.
Freeing your schedule is good. Freeing your thinking is the real advantage.
Full breakdown is in the blog — link in the comments.
